payout_command_check.name: payout_command_check
payout_command_check.value:
"payout"."status" = 'draft' or ("payout"."bank_id" is not null and "payout"."account_type" is not null
        and "payout"."account_number" is not null and "payout"."holder_name" is not null
        and "payout"."holder_legal_id_type" is not null and "payout"."holder_legal_id" is not null
        and "payout"."recipient_email" is not null and "payout"."command_hash" is not null)

payout_dispatch_check.name: payout_dispatch_check
payout_dispatch_check.value:
("payout"."status" not in ('submitting', 'submitted', 'uncertain') or "payout"."first_dispatch_at" is not null)
        and (("payout"."first_dispatch_at" is null) = ("payout"."retry_deadline" is null))

payout_lease_check.name: payout_lease_check
payout_lease_check.value: ("payout"."status" = 'submitting') = ("payout"."lease_token" is not null and "payout"."lease_expires_at" is not null)
